text_block_list.text:
Since Aston Machan wasn't feeling well,
I brought her to the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Whew, good night for a little while.
I promise I'll wake up as a healthy, energetic Machan...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
*land*.
*patter-patter-patter*...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is Agent Chan.
Classified intel safely secured.

text_block_list.name: Boss
text_block_list.text:
"Roger that, well done.
Return to base immediately."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, roger th—

text_block_list.name: Men Dressed in Black
text_block_list.text:
There's Curren Chan!
Don't let her get away!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Nunu, pursuers.
However, getting caught is not an option.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Chan is a master spy
travelling the world.

text_block_list.name: Man Dressed in Black
text_block_list.text: ...Are you really sure about this?

text_block_list.name: Man Dressed in Black
text_block_list.text: A spy is a figure of the shadows. One who remains in no one's memories—

text_block_list.name: Man Dressed in Black
text_block_list.text: In other words, wouldn't that contradict your original goal? You know, becoming "Chan, the World-Renowned Mascot"?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, fair point.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: However, it is fine.

text_block_list.name: Man Dressed in Black
text_block_list.text: What!?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
On the surface, a world-famous mascot loved by everyone.
However! In the shadows, a world-class spy!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I think having something like that works too!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that works. It totally works.
Hehehe, I can't just sit still now...!

When Aston Machan returned afterward,
she was in an uncharacteristically great mood
and looked to be in top form.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That would be troublesome too, hmm.
A spy who stands out, hmm...

text_block_list.name: Man Dressed in Black
text_block_list.text:
That's why I told you to quit spying...
Oh well, take him away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Aaaawaaay I gooo.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "...Is spying simply not meant for Chan after all?"

Perhaps because she spent her dream worrying,
Aston Machan couldn't get a proper rest
and hasn't recovered her form...
